facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central point of contact for all students in the department with questions related to international matters. It specifically advises students on organizing a study abroad and supervises guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

facts.value: International students receive an easier start at Goethe University and in Frankfurt through a Frankfurt Buddy. Experienced students provide support in navigating the campus, studying, and life in Frankfurt, while also allowing for intercultural and linguistic exchange.
